Hi Marissa,

I signed up via the self-serve flow and would love to schedule a quick 15-minute technical screen before we commit to a full demo. We want to confirm a few integration details (data residency, auth/SSO, and latency expectations) and make sure the right folks join.

I’m available Wed Mar 3 between 3:00–4:00 PM PT or Thu morning (9:00–11:00 PT). If possible, I’d prefer to speak with an engineer/solutions person for this short triage.

Can you let me know what works?

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up and for the quick note. We can absolutely do a 15-minute technical triage prior to a full demo. I’ve proposed two short slots on Wed Mar 3 PT: 3:15–3:30 PM PT or 3:45–4:00 PM PT. Do either of those work for you?

I’ve looped in Aditya (Solutions Engineer) and Ben (AE) — Aditya would be the best person to run the triage. If you’d like the AE on the call as well, we can include Ben, but for a focused technical check 15 minutes + SE is usually ideal.

I can send a calendar invite (ICS) for the confirmed slot. Also, if you can quickly reply with answers to:
- Primary cloud provider/region for data
- Expected daily token/usage volume (ballpark)
- Any compliance constraints (SOC2, GDPR, on-prem requirements)

That will help us come prepared.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa — please book that slot. For the triage, I’ll focus on the following quick checklist (I’ve attached a one-page PDF):
- Cloud provider & region (to validate data residency)
- Data ingress pattern (S3/stream/API) and approximate throughput
- Auth model (SSO/SAML/OAuth, KMS/HSM requirements)
- Latency/throughput SLOs and max sequence lengths
- Any specific models or custom weights you plan to use

If Alex can reply with short answers to the bullets above or drop a link to a shared doc, that will make the 15 minutes productive.

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

3:15–3:30 PM PT on Wed Mar 3 works for us. Thanks for the quick turn. I’ll confirm the calendar invite once you send it.

Quick answers to Aditya’s checklist:
- Cloud/provider: AWS, us-west-2
- Ingress: S3 uploads + occasional API pulls; expected ~50–100k tokens/day initially
- Auth/KMS: SAML SSO; we use AWS KMS for key management and would need BYOK options
- Latency SLO: <500ms for interactive inference; batch jobs have higher tolerance
- Models: evaluating open Llama variants, possibly some finetuned weights later

Let us know if you need any VPN or sample data beforehand. Looking forward to the 15-minute triage.

Best,
Alex
Head of Data | Acme Analytics
